# EaseIntoAI

> Practical AI education, workflow support, and organization programs for people who want to use AI well in real work.

EaseIntoAI helps individuals, professionals, businesses, and organizations understand where AI is useful, apply it to real work, evaluate its results, and keep human judgment in control. The company is based in Delaware, with virtual learning and partnership conversations available more broadly.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://easeintoai.co/): Audience pathways, practical AI solutions, founder story, and current learning opportunities
- [For Organizations](https://easeintoai.co/for-organizations): Hands-on AI programs and focused pilots for chambers, libraries, nonprofits, employers, workforce groups, and public organizations
- [Courses](https://easeintoai.co/courses): Available self-paced courses and a concise view of programs in development
- [Custom AI Assistants](https://easeintoai.co/custom-ai-assistant): Guided implementation using approved information and human review
- [Past Webinars](https://easeintoai.co/past-webinars): Archive of completed sessions and documented learning outcomes
- [Insights](https://easeintoai.co/insights): Plain-language explanations, business examples, workshop lessons, updates, and webinar recaps
- [Contact](https://easeintoai.co/book): Schedule a conversation or use the email fallback

## Approach

- Start with real work and real community needs
- Explain AI in plain language
- Support implementation, not awareness alone
- Protect sensitive information and maintain human review
- Begin with a focused task or pilot and expand only when useful

Frameworks and external resources may be referenced for education. References do not imply endorsement, certification, affiliation, or partnership.

Contact: hello@easeintoai.co
